name: Gimenells i el Pla de la Font (Spain)
description: Vertical tricolour of yellow, light blue and yellow, the yellow stripes each charged with a roundel barry wavy of white and light blue.
history: Municipal flag of Gimenells i el Pla de la Font; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: roundel barry wavy of white and light blue
